description: The tavern is lively when Aelis begins her first night. Firelight flickers across crowded tables where merchants, farmers, and caravan guards share drinks and stories. Normally the evening's mood is guided by the fiddler, but tonight he has not arrived. Without music the atmosphere grows restless. Tankards tap against tables and impatient clapping spreads through the room. The keeper glances toward Aelis and shrugs slightly, as if offering her the opportunity to fill the silence. The open space near the hearth becomes the center of attention. Some patrons laugh and call for entertainment, while others simply watch with curiosity. For Aelis, this moment could shape how the tavern sees her from now on. A good first impression could earn admiration and coin. A poor one might make the crowd dismiss her entirely.

choices.option: Walk between the tables first, charming the guests before dancing.
choices.message_success: Aelis jokes and spins playfully beside different tables, warming the room before beginning her dance. The crowd is already smiling when the performance begins. (+3 Charm, +150 gold, +3 tavern reputation)
choices.message_failure: Aelis tries to charm the guests but struggles to connect. The dance that follows feels rushed. (+1 Charm, +50 gold, +1 tavern reputation)

choices.option: Attempt a flashy move you have never practiced.
choices.message: The daring flourish begins well but ends in a small stumble that breaks the crowd's excitement. (+1 Charm, -60 gold, -1 tavern reputation)

choices.option: Dance to the rhythm of the patrons' clapping.
choices.message_success: Aelis gradually shapes the uneven rhythm into something lively and earns cheerful applause. (+2 Charm, +120 gold, +2 tavern reputation)
choices.message_failure: Aelis tries to follow the clapping but loses the beat. The performance feels disjointed. (+1 Charm, +40 gold, +1 tavern reputation)

description: A group of wandering musicians arrives carrying unfamiliar instruments from distant lands. Their melodies are unusual but energetic, quickly drawing attention from the crowd. Curious patrons gather near the hearth as the musicians begin playing. They invite Aelis to join their performance, eager to see how a dancer handles their strange rhythms. The patrons lean forward eagerly. Something new always excites a tavern crowd, but unfamiliar performances can also fall flat if they feel awkward or forced. The moment offers Aelis a chance to show adaptability and creativity.

choices.option: Refuse to dance to such strange music.
choices.message: The musicians leave offended and the crowd complains about the lost entertainment. (+1 Charm, -90 gold, -2 tavern reputation)

choices.option: Ask for a slower tune suited to graceful dancing.
choices.message_success: The musicians adjust their melody and Aelis performs a refined dance that earns warm applause. (+2 Charm, +180 gold, +3 tavern reputation)
choices.message_failure: The musicians try to adapt but the result feels stiff. The crowd applauds politely. (+1 Charm, +80 gold, +2 tavern reputation)

choices.option: Adapt to the unfamiliar rhythm and improvise.
choices.message_success: Her quick thinking impresses the room and travelers begin speaking about her talent. (+3 Charm, +210 gold, +4 tavern reputation)
choices.message_failure: Aelis tries to improvise but the unfamiliar rhythm throws her off. The crowd enjoys it anyway. (+1 Charm, +120 gold, +3 tavern reputation)

description: A wealthy cloth merchant arrives boasting loudly about the expensive silks he sells to nobles. While watching Aelis perform he tosses a shimmering length of fabric toward her with a smug grin. "Let us see if a tavern dancer can make this worthy of court," he declares. The patrons lean forward eagerly.

choices.option: Incorporate the silk into your performance.
choices.message_success: The cloth swirls beautifully through the air, reflecting the firelight with every spin. Even the merchant applauds. (+3 Charm, +300 gold, +6 tavern reputation)
choices.message_failure: Aelis weaves the silk into her dance but a misstep sends it flying. The merchant smirks. (+1 Charm, +150 gold, +2 tavern reputation)

choices.option: Continue dancing normally and ignore the challenge.
choices.message: The performance remains enjoyable, though the spectacle feels slightly less impressive. (+2 Charm, +240 gold, +4 tavern reputation)

choices.option: Insult the merchant and throw the cloth aside.
choices.message: Offended, the merchant storms out and takes several customers with him. (+1 Charm, -150 gold, -3 tavern reputation)

description: A cloaked visitor begins appearing regularly. Unlike most patrons he drinks little and watches Aelis closely during her performances. His posture and fine clothing suggest someone familiar with noble courts. Some regulars whisper that he might be a steward serving a lord in the nearby city. Whatever the truth, his attention could prove valuable — or troublesome.

choices.message: Offended by the accusation, the man leaves immediately. The keeper scolds Aelis afterward. (+1 Charm, -180 gold, -4 tavern reputation)

choices.option: Perform a refined dance meant for noble audiences.
choices.message_success: After the performance the stranger quietly leaves behind a generous purse of coins. (+4 Charm, +360 gold, +7 tavern reputation)
choices.message_failure: Aelis attempts an elegant dance but nerves show. The stranger leaves without a word. (+2 Charm, +180 gold, +3 tavern reputation)

choices.option: Approach him politely after the performance.
choices.message_success: The man reveals himself to be a noble steward and promises to mention her talent in the city. (+3 Charm, +300 gold, +6 tavern reputation)
choices.message_failure: Aelis approaches but the man remains guarded. He leaves a modest tip. (+2 Charm, +200 gold, +4 tavern reputation)

description: Word of Aelis' performances eventually reaches the nearby city. One evening several elegant carriages arrive outside. Curious nobles step inside, eager to witness the dancer they have heard about. The tavern fills beyond capacity as both locals and visiting aristocrats gather around the hearth. Tonight's performance could make Aelis' reputation spread far beyond the room.

choices.option: Blend tavern energy with elegant courtly steps.
choices.message_success: Nobles and commoners alike cheer as the performance bridges both worlds. (+3 Charm, +420 gold, +9 tavern reputation)
choices.message_failure: Aelis tries to blend styles but the mix feels uneven. The nobles applaud politely. (+2 Charm, +280 gold, +6 tavern reputation)

choices.option: Drink heavily with the crowd before performing.
choices.message: The sloppy dance disappoints the visiting nobles, who leave early. (+1 Charm, -240 gold, -5 tavern reputation)

choices.option: Perform a precise and graceful courtly dance.
choices.message_success: The nobles applaud with admiration and speak of her elegance throughout the city. (+4 Charm, +450 gold, +10 tavern reputation)
choices.message_failure: Aelis performs well but a small stumble costs her perfection. The nobles are impressed nonetheless. (+3 Charm, +350 gold, +7 tavern reputation)
